title: Itandukaniro rya 360p, 720p na 1080p: Wahitamo Ubuhe Bwiza?
description: Ni irihe tandukaniro ry'ubwiza bwa videwo 360p, 720p na 1080p? Menya icyo resolution ivuze, uko igira ingaruka ku ngano ya dosiye, n'uko wahitamo neza.
body:
Iyo ukuramo videwo, akenshi uhabwa amahitamo menshi nka 360p, 720p na 1080p. None wahitamo iyihe? Iyi nyandiko isobanura mu magambo yoroshye itandukaniro ry'ubwiza bwa videwo 360p, 720p na 1080p, kugira ngo ushobore guhitamo resolution ihuye n'ibyo ukeneye, ipaki ya interineti ufite n'ububiko bwa telefoni yawe.

Imibare 360p, 720p na 1080p Isobanura Iki?

Iyi mibare yerekana resolution, ni ukuvuga umubare w'imirongo ya pixel ku ruhande rugufi rwa videwo. Uko umubare uba munini, ni ko videwo ishobora kwerekana utuntu twinshi. Inyuguti “p” ikomoka kuri progressive scan, uburyo bwo kwerekana amashusho bukoreshwa cyane muri videwo z'ikoranabuhanga.

  • 360p: hafi 640 × 360 pixel kuri videwo itambitse. Ni ubwiza busanzwe bwo hasi.
  • 720p: hafi 1280 × 720 pixel, ikunze kwitwa HD.
  • 1080p: hafi 1920 × 1080 pixel, izwi nka Full HD.

Ku videwo zihagaze nk'izikwirakwira cyane ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, ibipimo birahinduka. Urugero, videwo ihagaze ya 1080p ifite hafi 1080 × 1920 pixel.

Itandukaniro ry'Ubwiza bwa Videwo 360p, 720p na 1080p mu Bikorwa

360p: izigama interineti n'ububiko

Iyi resolution itanga dosiye ntoya kurusha izindi. Ishusho iracyagaragara bihagije kuri ecran ntoya ya telefoni, ariko inyandiko ntoya n'utuntu two mu maso bishobora kugaragara nabi gato. Ikwiye niba ushaka gusa kubika videwo isekeje yo kureba vuba, cyangwa iyo ipaki ya interineti yenda gushira.

720p: ihitamo riringaniye

Ku bantu benshi, 720p ni hagati heza. Ishusho iba igaragara neza kuri ecran ya telefoni, mu gihe dosiye ikiri ntoya kurusha iya 1080p. Iri hitamo rikwiye amasomo, uburyo bwo guteka, cyangwa videwo ushaka kureba inshuro nyinshi.

1080p: igaragara neza kurusha izindi

Niba utuntu duto ari ingenzi, urugero videwo y'ahantu nyaburanga, isomo ririmo inyandiko ntoya, cyangwa videwo ushaka kurebera kuri tablet, mudasobwa cyangwa televiziyo, hitamo 1080p. Ingaruka zabyo ni uko dosiye iba nini kandi gukuramo bigatwara igihe kirekire.

Ingano ya Dosiye n'Ipaki ya Interineti

Muri rusange, uko resolution iri hejuru, ni ko dosiye iba nini. Ariko ingano nyayo iterwa kandi n'igihe videwo imara, ingano y'urujya n'uruza ruyirimo, n'uburyo yagabanyijwe (compression). Videwo ebyiri zimara igihe kimwe zishobora kugira ingano zitandukanye. Bityo, aho gukeka imibare, ibuka iri tegeko ryoroshye: niba ububiko cyangwa interineti ari bike, manura resolution.

Uko Wahitamo Ubwiza Mu Gihe Ukuramo

Kuri I Need Save, guhitamo ubwiza biroroshye cyane:

  1. Muri app y'urubuga nkoranyambaga, kanda Sangiza (Share) hanyuma Koporora link (Copy link).
  2. Fungura ineedsave.com maze womeke link mu gasanduku kabugenewe, cyangwa ukande Omeka.
  3. Kanda Kuramo.
  4. Reba urutonde rw'amahitamo ya videwo agaragara, hanyuma uhitemo resolution ushaka.

Amahitamo aboneka aterwa n'inyandiko y'umwimerere. Hari videwo zifite amahitamo kuva kuri 360p kugeza kuri 1080p, izindi zigatanga ubwiza bumwe cyangwa bubiri gusa. Niba buto yanditseho Birimo gutegurwa…, tegereza gato; videwo irimo gutunganywa kandi gukuramo biratangira ubwabyo.

Guhitamo 1080p ntibishobora gutuma videwo yari isanzwe idasobanutse igaragara neza. Ubwiza bwa dosiye ukuyemo ntibushobora kurenga ubwa videwo uwayikoze yashyizeho.

Bite se kuri Codec ya HEVC na H.264?

Uretse resolution, hari ikindi kintu kigena niba videwo izakina neza: codec. Videwo zimwe za TikTok zikoresha codec ya HEVC (H.265). Ubu buryo burakora neza, ariko telefoni zishaje cyane zishobora kutayikina neza. Ihitamo rya H.264 rikina ku bikoresho hafi ya byose. Bityo, niba videwo icikagurika kuri telefoni ishaje, gerageza kongera kuyikuramo ukoresheje irindi hitamo rihari. Ibisobanuro byose biri mu nyandiko videwo wakuyemo yanga gukina.

Ukeneye Ijwi Gusa?

Niba icyo ukeneye ari umuziki cyangwa ijwi rya videwo gusa, ntukeneye gukuramo videwo ya 1080p. Hitamo Amajwi, haba mu bwiza bw'umwimerere cyangwa MP3 ya 192 kbps ihinduwe ivuye muri videwo. Ingano yayo akenshi iba nto cyane kandi ishobora gukinwa ako kanya muri app y'umuziki. Uburyo busobanuwe mu mabwiriza uko wahindura videwo zo ku mbuga nkoranyambaga MP3.

Ubwiza ubwo ari bwo bwose wahitamo, koresha videwo wakuyemo ku giti cyawe kandi wubahe uburenganzira bw'abahanzi. Saba uruhushya mbere yo kongera kuzishyira ku rubuga kandi uvuge izina rya nyirazo.

Ibibazo Bikunze Kubazwa

Ni ubuhe bwiza bushyigikiwe cyane?

Kureba kuri telefoni, 720p akenshi irahagije. Hitamo 1080p niba ushaka kurebera kuri ecran nini, na 360p niba ushaka kuzigama ububiko.

Kuki nta hitamo rya 1080p rihari?

Amahitamo y'ubwiza akurikiza videwo y'umwimerere. Niba uwayikoze yayishyizeho muri resolution yo hasi, cyangwa urubuga rutanga gusa ubwiza runaka, ihitamo rya 1080p ntirizagaragara.

Ese videwo ya 1080p itinda kuvamo?

Akenshi yego, kuko dosiye iba nini. Umuvuduko kandi uterwa na interineti yawe.
